name: DN_step_map
aliases: Voxel Raycasting with Axis-Aligned Grid Traversal
Voxel Raycasting with Incremental Face Traversal
definition: Casts a ray into the voxel volume to find the first intersecting voxel, returning hit position, voxel data, and surface normal.
summary: DN_step_map is a voxel traversal algorithm that efficiently determines the sequence of voxels intersected by a ray by using precomputed distances to jump directly to the next voxel boundary, avoiding explicit intersection tests.
